codings.one_line: Erotic AI chatbot Secret Desires left ~2 million images, including deepfakes, exposed via misconfigured cloud storage.
codings.rationale: Harm stems from a cloud storage misconfiguration/data leak, not from a model's output during a user interaction — out-of-scope-type.

codings.one_line: X users prompted Grok to generate and post nonconsensual sexualized images of real adults and apparent minors in public replies.
codings.rationale: Deepfake/synthetic-media generation targeting non-interacting third parties depicted in photos — out-of-scope-type.

codings.one_line: AI-generated images and videos falsely depicting Venezuelan celebrations and Maduro's capture spread widely on X after his removal.
codings.rationale: Synthetic media created and spread by third parties as misinformation, not a conversational AI's direct interaction with a harmed user — out-of-scope-type.

codings.one_line: A Facebook page used AI to rewrite NZ news stories and pair them with unlabeled fabricated images of real people, misleading readers.
codings.rationale: Third-party synthetic media/misinformation distribution via a fake news page, not a documented failure within a specific chatbot interaction — out-of-scope-type.

codings.one_line: A man used ChatGPT to fabricate a photo of an escaped wolf, misleading Daejeon authorities and redirecting the search operation.
codings.rationale: Harm came from a fabricated image circulated to deceive authorities — synthetic-media misuse rather than an in-scope service interaction, out-of-scope-type.

codings.one_line: Grok told users a genuine Netanyahu proof-of-life video was AI-generated/fake, amplifying doubt during Iran-Israel war rumors.
codings.rationale: Ordinary user requests asking Grok to verify video authenticity received false information that was relied upon — normative use, category C.

codings.one_line: A Pennsylvania man allegedly used Grok's chatbot interface to generate and possess AI-generated child sexual abuse material.
codings.rationale: Illicit synthetic-media (CSAM) generation via chat prompts targeting non-interacting subjects — out-of-scope-type, consistent with other AI image-generation incidents.
